items.title: Victor Rendon interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, June 12, 2020 [interview 2 of 2]
items.q: So I started out with Count Basie in the middle. I listened to some Quincy Jones and this and that.

ctx.x: Okay well just to wrap up, when you get up in the morning do you put music on?

Yes. I’ve been — it’s funny you mention that because one of the things we talk about on Wednesdays when I meet with that Zoom meeting is that we recommend recordings that we listen to throughout the week and also movies that maybe we saw. So in the morning while I’m scanning or doing something I’ll put on something. As you can see behind me I have a lot of vinyl. The top is all Latino stuff, the middle is jazz. So my original idea was to go one by one. But I must have at least 3000 records. There’s no way I can…
Yes, I’ve been revisiting my Cannonball Adderley LPs.
